50 | Far Voice | caster +1 tgt | C | varies | Fm

# Descriptions
@@ 1
The caster may mentally speak with another spell user of the Mentalism realm.
They must be able to see each other or the caster must know the exact location
of the target or the caster must use Focus Voice to locate the target (in all
cases, the target must be within range).
@@ 2
The caster enters a trance-like state to prepare his mind to be the recipient
for a Star Voice spell, Mind Voice spell or Mind Tongue spell (off Mind Speech
(Mentalist Base)). While he is under the effects of this spell, an incoming
spell belonging to one of the three groups mentioned above will have its range
increased by 10 times.
@@ 3
As Star Voice, except the caster may mentally speak with any one thinking
being that he can see.
@@ 4
When this spell is cast, the next Star Voice or Mind Voice spell (cast within
one minute of this spell) will be able to focus in on a specific person as its
target (even if the caster cannot see the target). The target must have
previously been Mind Stored (see the Starsense spell list).
@@ 5
As Star Voice, except the caster may speak to another spell user of the
Mentalism realm as far as the horizon if it is clear and at night, In other
circumstances, the range is 1000’.
@@ 6
As Mind Voice I, except the range is 300’ and the caster must know exactly
where the target is.
@@ 7
As Prepare Voice I, except the range is increased by 20 times.
@@ 8
As Mind Voice III, except the range is 500’.
@@ 9
Caster can cause his voice to be heard at a point up to 100’ away (in
amplified tones). If the location is out of sight, the caster must have been
there.
@@ 10
As Mind Voice III, except the range is 1000’.
@@ 11
As Prepare Voice I, except the range is increased by 50 times.
@@ 12
A mental message (of up to 25 words) can be stored and set to be delivered to
a person entering the area of effect (with a trigger). The triggering area
must be no larger than 10’R and the trigger can be any of the following: a
fixed time period (up to 24 hours), specified movements, specified sounds,
touch, or by a specified person entering the area (that person must have been
Mind Stored by the caster; see the Starsense spell list).
@@ 13
As Long Voice I, except the point can be up to 300’ away.
@@ 14
As Mind Voice III, except the range is 1 mile.
@@ 15
As Star Voice, except the range is 5 miles per level of the caster if the
spell is cast on a clear night, and 1 mile per level of the caster under other
conditions.
@@ 16
As Prepare Voice I, except the range is increased by 100 times.
@@ 17
As Long Voice I, except the point can be up to 500’ away.
@@ 18
As Greater Mind Voice I, except the range is 5 miles.
@@ 19
As Prepare Voice I, except range is increased by 500 times.
@@ 20
As Long Voice I, except the point can be up to 100’ per level away.
@@ 25
As Mind Voice III, except the range is 1 mile per level of the caster.
@@ 30
As Long Voice I, except the point can be up to 1 mile per level away.
@@ 50
As Mind Voice III, except if the target of this spell is another spell user of
the Mentalism realm, the range is unlimited; otherwise, the range is 5 miles
per level of the caster.
